---
title: "Linear Direct realization"
---

Use Direct to evaluate the linear network authored by one Plan and selected by
its `NetworkViewRef`. Parameter values bind that same Plan before the selected
View is realized; the solver does not own a second circuit description.

## Plan, View, and response {#direct-and-hb-selected-network}

The compiled network preserves component identities, logical Port attachments,
Port direction and reference impedance. PTC, coordinate transforms and retention
apply through the selected View. Each Result retains its own requested grid,
ordered coordinates, units and numerical evidence.

Direct realizes resistors, inductors, capacitors and complete RLGC line models
through the physical C/K/G and terminal boundary. Josephson junctions use their
declared zero-phase, zero-bias small-signal inductance and explicit parallel
capacitance. SQUID components retain their authored two-junction finite-loop
topology with those linear branches.

Use matrix families S, Y and Z for the declared boundary. Coordinate-selected
quantities retain their own admissibility and failure contracts; a coordinate
selection does not automatically define a realizable Port boundary.

## Diagrams and returned Results

A caller-declared diagram presents the original authored Plan. It does not
select an analysis View or display the circuit after PTC, transforms or
retention. Read the Result's coordinates and View lineage for that analysis.

HB V1 is removed from 1.0. Its supersession and original contract are retained
in [HB V1 History](../implementation/hb-realization-and-outcomes.qmd).
